title: Apprentice (ITI-Electrician, Diploma Electrical, Diploma Civil, Graduate Electrical, Graduate Civil)
qualification: B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engg.) in Civil Engineering (full-time, 4-year course) - not notified in SR-I
total_posts: 270 (computed by summing region-wise totals; see Vacancy section)
salary: The monthly stipend structure is uniform across all 10 regions, subject to satisfactory performance and attendance. || An additional ₹2,500 per month is payable if company accommodation is not provided or availed || The DBT portion is provided by the Government of India under the NATS scheme, subject to an active Aadhaar-seeded, DBT-enabled bank account || Apprentices are entitled to 12 days of Casual Leave (pro-rata) and 15 days of Medical Leave for the one-year duration, across all regions
age_limit: Minimum age: Candidates must have completed 18 years of age at the time of application, across all regions || Applicants must be Indian citizens and at least 18 years old at the time of application || No maximum age limit or age relaxation details are specified in any of the 10 regional notifications || Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.
selection_process: Applications are screened in merit order based on eligibility criteria and the qualification prescribed for each trade, region-wise || Incomplete or ineligible applications are summarily rejected without intimation || Reservation for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD is applied as per the Apprentices Act, 1961 || Candidates are called for document verification in a ratio of 1:5 against the notified training slots, in merit order || Shortlisted candidates are informed through their registered email; no TA/DA is paid for attending document verification || A final merit list is prepared from candidates found suitable after document verification || Selected candidates must accept a tripartite apprenticeship contract on the NATS/NAPS portal and submit a medical certificate and police verification before engagement || For PwBD candidates in Western Region-II, reservation/relaxation is subject to submission of a medical certificate for permanent disability, and only candidates with not less than 40% of the relevant disability are eligible for the PwBD benefit

title: Post Name
qualification: Candidates must have passed out during 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, or 2025 (within the last 5 years from the date of passing the qualifying exam and date of joining training). Qualification requirements by category: || Category I – Graduate Apprentices (Engineering): BE/B.Tech in Civil Engineering; or Electrical/Electronics & Power Engineering (or a combination of basic Electrical sub-streams) for Electrical Engineering; or Electrical/Electronics/Information Technology/Communication Engineering/Computer Science & Engineering/Computer Science/Computer Engineering (or a combination of these basic streams) for Electronics Engineering; or Mechanical/Industrial/Automobile/Production Engineering for Mechanical Engineering - from an AICTE-recognized university. || Category II – Technician (Diploma) Apprentices: Diploma in Civil Engineering; or Electrical/Electronics & Power Engineering (or a combination of basic streams) for Electrical; or Electrical/Electronics/Information Technology/Communication Engineering/Computer Science & Engineering/Computer Science/Computer Engineering (or a combination) for Electronics; or Mechanical/Industrial/Automobile/Production Engineering for Mechanical - from a University or Institution recognized by the Central/State Govt. Technical Education Board or University. || Category III – Graduate Apprentices (General Stream): Bachelor of Arts / Science / Commerce / Business Administration / Management Science / Journalism and Mass Communication / Business Studies from a UGC or Central/State Govt./Technical Education Board recognized University or Institute. || No additional weightage is given for a higher qualification than the minimum prescribed. Candidates who have already undergone or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices (Amendment) Act, 1973 in any Government/PSU/Private Industrial Organization are not eligible.
salary: Stipend is paid through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mechanism, combining the Government of India's DBT share and KRCL's establishment share. || Candidates must have a bank account in their own name and a PAN card to receive the stipend, and must retain the same Aadhaar-linked bank account until training completion. Candidates must also make their own lodging and boarding arrangements during training.
age_limit: Age Limit: 18 to 25 years as on 1 January 2026 (date of birth between 1 January 2001 and 1 January 2008). || Age relaxation is subject to submission of the required documents at the time of Document Verification. || To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

title: Post Name
qualification: Candidates from the SC/ST/PwBD categories must have scored 50% or more marks, while candidates in other categories need 55% or more marks in the essential qualification. Rounding off of percentage is not permitted; for example, 54.99% will not be considered as 55%.
salary: Selected candidates will be placed in the following IDA (Industrial Dearness Allowance) pay scales: || In addition to Basic Pay and IDA, selected candidates will be entitled to attractive perquisites and benefits, including: || Allowances @ 35% of Basic Pay under the Cafeteria Approach || HRA / Company-leased accommodation || Contributory Provident Fund || Conveyance Reimbursement || Leave Encashment || Performance Related Pay || Medical Facility || Gratuity || Contributory Pension
age_limit: Minimum age for all posts is 18 years, and applicants must be Indian Nationals. Upper age limit inclusive of all relaxations shall not exceed 55 years.
application_fee: Application fee: Rs. 500 plus GST @ 18% (non-refundable), to be paid online. || SC/ST/PwBD/ESM/EWS candidates are exempted from payment of the application fee. || The application process is treated as complete only after submission of the application fee (where applicable). || Application fee is non-refundable even if the candidature is rejected for any reason.
selection_process: Scrutiny of applications based on the job specifications. || SJVN Management reserves the right to conduct a screening test to restrict the number of candidates called for the Personal Interview, if required. || If conducted, the screening test is qualifying in nature only (50% qualifying marks for UR/EWS/ESM and 40% for other reserved categories) and carries no weightage in the final merit list. || Document verification of shortlisted candidates. || Personal Interview - final selection and merit list are based purely on marks secured in the interview. || Qualifying marks in the interview: 50% for UR/EWS/ESM and 40% for SC/ST/PwBD/OBC (NCL). || Candidates have the option to appear for the Personal Interview in Hindi or English. || Experienced candidates with experience beyond the prescribed minimum may be considered for service weightage by the Selection Committee. || Candidates who qualify in the Personal Interview will be adjudged suitable for empanelment, and the offer of appointment will be issued in order of category-wise merit, subject to requirement and medical fitness.
